page: UpCloud GPU-24xCPU-480GB-2xH100 is a GPU-accelerated server configured with 24 Intel Xeon 8462Y+ vCPUs on the x86_64 architecture, running at 2.0 GHz. The processor features 24 physical cores with a single thread per core and a shared CPU allocation model. The system is equipped with 480.0 GB of system memory, providing 20.0 GB per core. Acceleration is driven by two NVIDIA Hopper H100 GPUs delivering a combined 160 GB of VRAM. There is no local storage bundled with this instance type.

Benchmark data shows top-tier performance in specific workloads, particularly in LLM inference where prompt processing for a small 135M model reaches 10,457.59 tokens per second and text generation reaches 366.07 tokens per second. Memory bandwidth is strong, with read-only large block speeds at 290.6 GB/sec and write speeds at 110.72 GB/sec. Single-threaded bzip3 decompression is also top-tier at 15.63 GB/sec. CPU performance is solid, with a PassMark CPU score of 55,980.84 and a stress-ng multi-core score of 52,357.03, both placing in the strong category.

From a resource density perspective, the server offers high memory-to-CPU allocation and massive GPU capabilities, making it highly efficient for large-scale parallel processing. However, the shared CPU allocation and lack of local storage represent key architectural tradeoffs that require external storage solutions. This server is suited for large language model inference, deep learning training, data science pipelines, and memory-intensive database operations.
